坐标轴注明统计对象。可用下方参数输入、滑块和播放按钮探索；图像只显示有限窗口。: Axes identify the statistical quantities. Explore with the parameter inputs, sliders, and playback controls below. The plot shows a finite window.
已到本次参数范围的终点。: This parameter run has reached its endpoint.
图示与读数对应当前参数；数值是浮点近似，有限图像不代替证明。: The plot and readouts use the current parameters. Numbers are floating-point approximations; finite plots do not replace proofs.
同一列的多条记录来自同一对象，不能自动视为独立样本。: Multiple records in the same column belong to the same unit; they are not automatically independent observations.
两组固定均值为十和二十。组成差可产生系统偏差，图示没有加入随机抽样。: The two subgroup means are fixed at ten and twenty. Differences in composition can create systematic bias; this diagram does not simulate random sampling.
构造例子中处理本身没有效应，差值完全来自基线组组成；不能将此差值解释为因果。: In this constructed example, treatment has no effect. The difference comes entirely from the groups' baseline compositions and cannot be interpreted as causal.
前四个观测固定为一、二、三、四；移动第五个点。中位数与样本标准差按原始数据计算。: The first four observations are fixed at one, two, three, and four; move the fifth point. The median and sample standard deviation are calculated from the raw data.
十个格子等可能；每格概率为十分之一。起始位置循环移动，重叠格只计一次。: The ten cells are equally likely, each with probability one tenth. The starting position cycles around, and overlapping cells are counted once.
所有格子按边缘乘积构造，因此模型独立。修改边缘不会破坏这个构造条件。: Every cell is constructed as a product of its marginals, so the model is independent. Changing the marginals preserves this construction.
阳性后的目标概率: Target probability after a positive result
抽象检测模型，行列格值均为总体联合概率；后验要用阳性列重新归一化。: This is an abstract detection model. Cells contain population joint probabilities; the posterior renormalizes the positive column.
具体正态尾部与只知均值方差的通用上界是不同信息层级。: An exact normal tail and a bound using only the mean and variance rely on different amounts of information.
相同均值 Poisson 近似: Poisson approximation with the same mean
青色为精确二项，金色折线为 Poisson 近似；距离计算还包括二项支持外的 P: Cyan shows the exact binomial masses; gold shows the Poisson approximation. The distance includes Poisson mass outside the binomial support.
原假设分布固定由成功概率确定；金色为观察成功数，右尾包含该计数。比例乘次数后四舍: The null distribution is determined by its success probability. Gold marks the observed count, which is included in the right tail. The proportion times the trial count is rounded to an integer.
成功数控件超出当前试验次数时，选中值取试验次数；读数中明确显示实际选中次数。: If the success-count control exceeds the number of trials, the selection is capped at that number. Readouts show the actual selected count.
目标成功数为一时是几何分布；更大时是负二项总等待次数。两者都包含最后成功那次试验: A target of one success gives a geometric distribution; larger targets give negative binomial waiting times. Both count the final successful trial.
总体三十件、目标十二件；青色不放回，金色为相同成功率的独立二项参照。: The population has thirty objects, twelve of them targets. Cyan shows sampling without replacement; gold is an independent binomial reference with the same success probability.
本模型明确假设独立正态总体，因此均值分布对所有显示样本量均精确正态。: This model assumes independent normal observations, so the sample mean is exactly normal for every displayed sample size.
选定行第一列的条件概率: Conditional probability of first column given selected row
两个边缘都固定为各一半。移动概率质量改变联合关系；仅当四格均为四分之一时独立。: Both marginals remain one half. Moving probability mass changes the joint relationship; independence holds only when all four cells equal one quarter.
四十个等权点构成一个有限总体；三角正交构造保证两边总体方差为一、相关为指定值。: Forty equally weighted points form a finite population. The trigonometric orthogonal construction gives both variables population variance one and the specified correlation.
两组各占一半、共同组内标准差固定为所选值。: The groups have equal weights and the selected common within-group standard deviation.

，每个柱是三百次重复抽样的有限结果；原总体始终是 Bernoulli，并未变正态: . The histogram uses three hundred repeated samples. The source population remains Bernoulli; it does not become normal.
；原数据为一、二、二、四和所选末值。每份抽五条。小样本仅用于方法演示，不承诺名义: . The original data are one, two, two, four, and the selected final value. Each resample has five observations. This small-sample demonstration does not guarantee nominal coverage.
曲线除以最大似然值便于比较形状；不是归一化的参数后验密度。: The curve is divided by its maximum likelihood to compare shapes. It is not a normalized posterior density for the parameter.
每个区间的半宽: Margin of error for each interval
真均值固定为零、已知总体标准差一；种子: The true mean is fixed at zero and the known population standard deviation is one. Seed
。绿色覆盖，金色未覆盖；每条可读具体端点。: . Green intervals contain the mean; gold intervals miss it. Each interval's endpoints are available in its tooltip.
名义水平为百分之九十五；Wald 端点可能越界，图形裁切但读数中保留半宽。成功数: The nominal confidence level is ninety-five percent. Wald endpoints can lie outside the valid range; the plot clips them, but the readout retains the full margin of error. The success count is the rounded product of the proportion and trial count.
两组独立，第一组样本标准差为三；两组样本量相同，第二组尺度可调。: The groups are independent. The first has sample standard deviation three; both have the same sample size, and the second group's scale is adjustable.
观察统计量可能超出有限绘图区；$p$ 值仍按实际统计量计算。检验尾部由本节模型预: The observed statistic may lie outside the finite plot window; the $p$-value still uses its actual value. The test tails are specified in advance by this lesson's model.
结果固定且每种两两分配等可能；原假设下的可交换性或锐零随机化条件是解释前提。: Outcomes are fixed, and every assignment to two groups of two is equally likely. Interpretation requires exchangeability under the null or randomization under a sharp null.
独立正态总体已知标准差一，预定双侧检验；真实效应为零时功效回到显著性水平。: Independent normal observations have known standard deviation one, and the two-sided test is prespecified. At zero true effect, power equals the significance level.
边缘均固定为三十、总数六十；这里不做 Yates 校正，采用 Pearson 渐: All row and column totals are thirty, with sixty observations in total. This uses Pearson's asymptotic statistic without Yates's correction.
可直接拖动金色第五个点，或用参数输入修改。纵向残差用金色虚线标出。: Drag the gold fifth point or use its parameter input. Gold dashed lines show vertical residuals.
青色虚线为逐点百分之九十五均值区间，粉色虚线为新观测预测区间；不是全曲线同时置信: Cyan dashed lines show pointwise ninety-five percent mean-response intervals; pink dashed lines show new-observation prediction intervals. These are not simultaneous confidence bands for the entire curve.
三组各三条，使用固定摘要演示；参数不会生成随机实验或证明误差模型成立。: Each of the three groups has three observations, using fixed summaries. Changing parameters does not generate a random experiment or establish the error assumptions.
后验均值与预测成功率: Posterior mean and predictive success probability
固定二十次 Bernoulli 试验。形状小于一时端点密度可无穷，曲线仅绘制内部: There are twenty fixed Bernoulli trials. Shape parameters below one can give infinite endpoint densities, so curves show only an interior window. Probabilities and quantiles use the full support.
